live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of the fresh block (borg-zoo#556, borg-reborn-rs PR #799 for P7). Pilot (RULES 16) of
the two builds on the first 18 starts of classes-1800-fresh, which shares no start with classes-1800, -b or any earlier
suite (checked); the full block is the owner's call. Endpoints fixed as P7 states: tactical = deaths by 100,000 engine turns
with mean max CL and depth within #347's margin; descent = alive at the cap having reached DL5 (primary), with its survival
margin. Gate: one binary per build; no config_error; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped (stalls, timeouts and
crashes kept apart); frozen-turn bursts classified. Report per build and per class: deaths and causes, CL at death, final and
maximum level, deepest level, alive at the cap having reached DL5; paired rescued and newly killed (then against now), identical
plays; the death report with screens for the deaths in now.
